svg.title: Step 7 mockup 15: Grids that scale: sessions with 3 and 12 at 1280, 1920 and 390 px (amendment 3)
svg.text: 15 · Grids that scale: sessions with 3 and 12 at 1280, 1920 and 390 px (amendment 3)
Use case: the Sessions page and a session's matches fill the width they have and stay balanced with few or many items
3 sessions · 1920 px: 5 columns of 304 px, two empty tracks kept
One .canccu-grid (card, 18 rem): columns come with the width, up to 120 rem; never a module's own columns.
auto-fill keeps empty tracks: 3 sessions keep their width at 1920 px instead of stretching.
Day headings split the grid into one grid per day (sheet 05); the crew band sits above, never beside.
Players, registrants, the history and the standings stay tables: they are compared column by column.
